# Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage — facts

## Structure and components

- [statement] MongoDB's covered-query requirements say a single index must contain every query field, fields needed internally for sharding, and every returned field; on mongos, the index must contain the shard key. A general compound-index guide also notes that _id must be indexed or excluded from the projection. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-optimization/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://github.com/OneUptime/blog/blob/master/posts/2026-01-30-mongodb-compound-index-strategies/README.md, https://stackoverflow.com/questions/76295889/mongodb-index-need-to-include-id-for-it-to-cover-if-projecting-id

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MongoDB's hashed-index manual says hashed indexes cannot cover a query. Its server test shows that find({_id: true}, {_id: 0}) against a collection sharded by {_id: "hashed"} still has totalDocsExamined: 1, so the hashed shard-key value is not returned from the index alone. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/ ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/jstests/sharding/covered_shard_key_indexes.js — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/jstests/sharding/covered_shard_key_indexes.js, https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/jstests/sharding/covered_shard_key_indexes.js
- [statement] With a single-field hashed shard key, mongos can target queries with equality matches to a single shard. Hashing gives a more even distribution (hashed keys suit monotonically changing fields), but documents with close shard key values are unlikely to share a chunk or shard, so mongos is more likely to broadcast a ranged query. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/hashed-sharding/ — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/hashed-sharding/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/create.md, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/configure-sharding-to-maximize-the-performance-of-shards
- [statement] MongoDB defines a compound hashed index as a compound index with a single hashed field, whose hash is used along with the other fields as the shard key. The hashed-index manual says hashed indexes can't cover a query; it does not separately address the compound case, so treating compound hashed indexes as non-covering is an inference. The cited server test checks only a single-field {_id: "hashed"} shard key. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/hashed-sharding/ ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/ — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/create.md, https://www.percona.com/blog/refining-shard-keys-in-mongodb-4-4-and-above/, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/jstests/sharding/covered_shard_key_indexes.js

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A compound hashed index hashes one field only and stores its other fields with ascending or descending order; the hashed field can be combined with ordinary fields before or after it. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/create.md · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/sharding-with-zones-based-on-compound-shard-keys-on-mongodb-4-4/, https://www.percona.com/blog/refining-shard-keys-in-mongodb-4-4-and-above/
- [statement] In a compound hashed shard key, the prefix non-hashed field or fields support zone ranges while the hashed field supports more even distribution of the sharded data. The hashed-index manual says hashed indexes can't cover a query; it does not separately address compound hashed indexes, so non-coverage for them is an inference. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/hashed-sharding/ ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/ — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/hashed-sharding/ · keywords: Hashed and compound hashed shard keys and index coverage · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/sharding-with-zones-based-on-compound-shard-keys-on-mongodb-4-4/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed/
